description: View of a man in a cowboy hat and jeans, leaning down on his haunches at the waters edge with his camera to his face, taking a picture.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (unidentified man)
